description: Derek Cameron appointed Vice-Chair of Municipal Planning Commission for 2025.
Approves day care for 20 children at 440 Evergreen Boulevard.

chips.text: Applicants explained staggered drop-off and pick-up times to manage traffic.
Applicants Kavita and Prem Sharma will operate the day care.

description: Rezones 1902 Broadway Avenue's southern portion to commercial.

chips.text: Commission asked about environmental remediation for the former gas station site.
Three individuals expressed support for the proposed rezoning after receiving information.
Environmental site remediation was confirmed for the former gas station site.

description: Aligns Official Community Plan, Zoning Bylaw with City Centre Plan.

chips.text: No public concerns were expressed regarding the plan amendments.

description: 2025 planning conference list tabled for future consideration.
